title: Forces Controlling Wind Movement
subject: Geography
description: A diagram outlining the primary forces that control wind movement: Pressure Gradient Force, Coriolis Force, and Friction, and their effects.
mermaidCode:
mindmap
    root((Forces Controlling Wind))
        Pressure Gradient Force
            Drives air from High to Low Pressure
            Stronger gradient = Stronger winds
        Coriolis Force
            Deflects air Right in NH
            Deflects air Left in SH
        Friction
            Acts opposite to wind motion
            Most effective near surface
